headline: Mutable plans, runtime semantics, and edge policy now carry exact authorities instead of plausible copies.

items.title: Canonical runtime operations
items.evidence: Capability operations and Architect Thesis HTTP semantics each resolve one shared authority with status-only and cross-runtime contract coverage.

items.title: Architecture Review
items.evidence: Declared philosophy is compared with source-derived current mastery, exact evidence delta, and one actionable next receipt without a causal claim.

items.title: State-bound trade authority
items.evidence: TradeService owns evaluate/commit and a deterministic plan fingerprint rejects stale roster, pick, cap, rule, or phase state before mutation.

items.title: Generated edge-security contract
items.evidence: Exact inline script/style hashes, hardening headers, security.txt, and one fingerprinted receipt are emitted by every static build.

items.title: Hosted policy attestation
items.evidence: Artifact fingerprint, exact revision, canonical health, and live response headers are joined without inferring deployment application.

followUps.title: Fresh next arc
followUps.evidence: The verified primary and viable second-order queues are exhausted; begin from a fresh live-code audit unless external release evidence changes.

blockers.title: Hosted release evidence family
blockers.evidence: Production remains HOLD on /_health, deployed revision, HSTS/CSP/frame/permissions headers, delivered email, approval, and lifecycle reconciliation.

honestyLedger.title: Generated is not deployed
honestyLedger.evidence: The exact local policy artifact is green; the live host remains HOLD and no repository file is treated as host application proof.

honestyLedger.title: No stale transaction
honestyLedger.evidence: A once-valid trade cannot mutate a changed league when the caller supplies the evaluated plan fingerprint.

honestyLedger.title: No causal mastery claim
honestyLedger.evidence: Architecture Review describes evidence and next action; it does not award hidden power, predict wins, or infer causation.

honestyLedger.title: No phantom launch
honestyLedger.evidence: Credential readiness, local success, and registry prose are not substituted for live health, headers, revision, delivery, approval, or lifecycle authority.
